params.body:
Replaces #269, which failed static analysis: `marksPerPupil()` declared `Collection<int, object>` while `keyBy` returned `(int|string)` keys. The pupils are now keyed by `(int)` id, as `whoWorksIn` already does, so the declared type is `Collection<int, stdClass>`. Nothing else differs from #269.

## What was wrong

The usage page's headline card "Leerlingen met scores" counted every pupil with a mark in a project of the school, enrolled or not, and set that against the pupils enrolled in a class of the school that year. Marks stay when an enrollment goes, so the figure could be higher than the number it is out of. On production on 2026-10-26, athena Heule read **336 van 335**: one pupil had marks and no enrollment in any school or year, and all 335 enrolled pupils had marks.

## What changes

- **Headline** (`UsageAnalytics::computeHeadline`): "Leerlingen met scores" now counts the pupils who have a mark and are enrolled in a class of the school in the window, so it never exceeds the enrolled count. Pupils with marks who are not enrolled there are counted apart (`pupils.withMarksNotEnrolled`). They are shown as one line under the card, and only when there is at least one: "1 leerling met scores is hier niet ingeschreven" / "N leerlingen met scores zijn hier niet ingeschreven". Their marks still count under Scores and in the charts, which keep adding up to the same total.
- **Through the years** reads the number from the headline, so it follows the fix.
- **Per class** was already right: it starts from the pupils in each class, so a pupil in no class counts in no row. Unchanged, now covered by a test.
- **One query for marks per pupil** (`marksPerPupil`), shared by the headline and per class. The headline used to get a single `count(distinct)` row; it now gets one row per pupil, the same query per class already ran.
- **Cache:** the headline is remembered under `headline.3`. A closed year is kept for good and a deploy leaves the usage store alone, so under `headline.2` the old count would stay on screen. The per-class key keeps its meaning and is not changed.
- **Rules:** R B8-2.4 defines the number; R B8-2.2 gets one sentence on pupils in no class.

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| 25 van 24 | 24 van 24, with "1 leerling met scores is hier niet ingeschreven" under it |

(Local demo with synthetic data: 24 enrolled pupils with marks, one with marks and no enrollment.)

## Tests

`TheUsageCountsEnrolledPupilsTest`:
- three pupils with a mark in a project of the school and no class there that year: one enrolled nowhere, one enrolled at another school, one enrolled at this school in the year before only;
- the line under the card: absent at 0, singular at 1, plural above;
- a headline left in the cache under the old key is not read.

All three tests fail on the old code. Eleven mutants (the old count, enrollment without the school or year filter, the apart count at 0 or at all marked pupils, marks limited to enrolled pupils, absences lost, the old cache key, the line at 0, never, or plural for one) are all killed. The usage tests and `RulesCoverageTest` pass (27), and PHPStan and Pint are clean on the workbench. The full suite has 21 failures on the workbench, the same 21 as on main (report PDFs and Chrome printing, archiving, BuildStamp, Vite manifest), none in the usage tests.

## After deploy

Closed years have nothing under the new key, so each one recalculates the first time it is opened. `php artisan naviskore:usage-warm` does that ahead of time.
params.title: Count pupils with marks on the usage page only when they are enrolled
